refnamediv.refpurpose: Create an input from a string

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoStringInputCreate function calls SilikoInputCreate to create a SilikoInput that reads from a duplicate of input_string. Since input_string is duplicated, it is still managed by the calling context.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: If successful, SilikoStringInputCreate returns a pointer to a new SilikoInput object returned by SilikoInputCreate. On failure, such as when out of memory, SilikoStringInputCreate retruns NULL.
